description: This file defines an interface 'IntStream' that specifies methods for a stream of integers used in parsing or interpretation, likely within a lexer or parser framework.

classes.name: IntStream
classes.description: An interface for a stream of integer tokens used in parsing processes.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the input stream by one token.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Returns the integer at the current input position plus 'i'.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Creates a mark in the stream to return to later.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current position index of the input stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream to a previously marked position.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a mark.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the input cursor to a specific index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the stream.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name of the input stream.
